articles.title: Western Alliance (WAL) Q3 2024 Earnings Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: Western Alliance (WAL) Q3 2024 Earnings Transcript. After I discuss our outlook for the remainder of 2024, Tim Bruckner will join us for Q&A. Western Alliance delivered solid third quarter results and earned $1.80 per share. During a transitional period for the rate cycle that began in Q3, net interest income grew 25% annualized due to higher average earning assets.
